```{r message=FALSE}
library(scml)
library(torch)
library(luz)
```



# Train a classifier on iris dataset
```{r message=FALSE}
fm <- train_delayed_classifier(
  data.matrix(iris[1:4]),
  iris$Species,
  pre_pruning_epoch = 50L,post_pruning_epoch = 50L,
  batch_size = 150L,
  valid_data = 0.1,
  input_dropout_rate = 0.1,
  accelerator = accelerator(cpu=TRUE)
)
```

learning curves
```{r}
plot(fm)
```

# performance on training set
```{r eval=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
pred <- predict_delayed(data.matrix(iris[1:4]),fm)
table(iris$Species,max.col(pred))
```



```{r}
fm <- train_delayed_classifier(
  data.matrix(iris[1:4]),
  iris$Species,
  batch_size = 150L,
  valid_data = 0.1,
  input_dropout_rate = 0.1,
  loss = nn_ordinal_regression_loss(1 - torch::torch_eye(3L)),
  accelerator = accelerator(cpu=TRUE)
)
```
